description: This file defines data structures, functions, and logic for parsing and handling talk configuration data within an application, including selection of provider configurations and resolving timeout values.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts a dictionary with String keys and Any values to a dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects a provider configuration based on input data, default provider, and fallback settings.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolvers positive integer values from AnyCodable types with fallback.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout milliseconds from a dictionary with fallback.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves provider configuration selection from a dictionary.
